subject: Operations
title: Corruption and Business Ethics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Corruption and Business Ethics.

hook.text: A bribe to a customs official clears your shipment in hours, not weeks. Ethical? Illegal? Many firms face this daily.

buildup.text: Corruption adds unpredictable costs and risks to global operations—bribes, kickbacks, and facilitation payments.

discovery.text: The US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and UK Bribery Act criminalize bribery abroad—even if it's common locally.

twist.text: Refusing bribes can cost contracts and slow operations. But paying them risks criminal prosecution and reputation.

climax.text: Transparent operations, strong compliance programs, and local partners with integrity are the best defenses.

punchline.text: Integrity is expensive short-term. Corruption is expensive long-term.

quiz.question: What law criminalizes US companies bribing foreign officials?
